MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 23
   C. 19
   D. 7

4. Solve for x: x + 7 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 15
   C. 8
   D. 9

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

6. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

7. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

8. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

11. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 15

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

13. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

14. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 3

15. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
